name: @ateliercartographie/label-placer
description: Render-agnostic automatic label placement for maps and charts: ordered candidate positions, priorities, obstacles, leader lines, pinned labels

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly && node scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push && git push --tags

author: Atelier de cartographie de Sciences Po
